description: This header file defines the classes and interfaces for the PixelShuffle and PixelUnshuffle modules in the PyTorch C++ frontend, including their implementation classes, options, and module holder types. It declares the structure of these neural network modules and associated methods.

classes.name: PixelShuffleImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for the PixelShuffle module, supporting the forward pass, reset, and pretty print functionalities, holding options for configuration.

classes.name: PixelUnshuffleImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for the PixelUnshuffle module, supporting the forward pass, reset, and pretty print functionalities, holding options for configuration.

methods.description: Outputs a human-readable description of the module.

methods.name: Tensor forward(const Tensor& input)
methods.description: Performs the pixel shuffle operation on the input tensor.
